records.name: Annali dell'Istituto Superiore di Sanità
records.scope_notes: Italian national public-health institute journal with a broad health-science remit. Existing-data population studies and evidence synthesis fit when they contribute to public health. Regional or Italian data should be compared with European or international evidence; laboratory and clinical work elsewhere in its scope falls outside OSRI's initial program.

route.conditions: English-language submissions. Normal limits are 6000 words for articles and 10000 for reviews; supplementary material is limited to two printed pages. ISS-affiliated authors need internal authorization. Optional printed subscriptions are reader purchases, not an author requirement. AI-assisted work requires disclosure in the manuscript and cover letter.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated for standard journal articles. Authors remain responsible for permissions for reused material.

fee_evidence.note: Current journal policy expressly excludes article and submission processing charges and any author publication fees.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty ranking established in expansion; independent ranking review pending.

records.name: Epidemiologia e Serviços de Saúde: revista do SUS
records.publisher: Secretaria de Vigilância em Saúde e Ambiente, Ministério da Saúde do Brasil
records.scope_notes: Population-health, epidemiology, management and policy evidence relevant to Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS). Existing-data analyses and systematic reviews fit; the Evidência em contexto category also accepts evidence synthesis, methods and policy interpretation. A concrete SUS contribution is required.

route.conditions: Submit in Portuguese. The publisher supplies English full-text and Spanish-abstract translation free. Original articles, including systematic reviews, normally allow 3000 words; Evidência em contexto allows 2000. Preprints are accepted with disclosure. Research articles require data-availability and applicable ethics statements.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None: official policy excludes submission, evaluation and publication charges and covers translation.

fee_evidence.note: Current journal policy identifies diamond access with no charges to authors or readers, expressly excludes submission/evaluation/publication fees, and states that translations are free and Ministry funded.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty ranking established in expansion; independent ranking review pending.

records.name: Journal of the College of Community Physicians of Sri Lanka
records.publisher: College of Community Physicians of Sri Lanka
records.scope_notes: Society journal covering epidemiology, demography, statistics, population health and health policy. Accepts local and international authors. Existing-data population studies and public-health reviews fit; manuscripts should address a contemporary public-health question.

route.conditions: English manuscripts. Studies normally must have been conducted within the past five years; older studies receive case-specific consideration. Reviews have a 4500-word limit. Authors should ensure adequate English, but the guidelines do not require buying an editing service or joining the college.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated for standard submission/publication; no membership prerequisite is stated.

fee_evidence.note: The current Publication Fees section explicitly says the journal charges neither submission nor publication fees.
About page independently excludes article-processing/publishing fees and confirms immediate open access.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty ranking established in expansion; independent ranking review pending.

records.name: Delaware Journal of Public Health
records.publisher: Delaware Academy of Medicine / Delaware Public Health Association
records.scope_notes: Society journal emphasizing Delaware and surrounding states; national/international work is considered at editorial discretion. Existing population-data research, systematic reviews and policy analysis need a clear connection to its regional public-health readership and an appropriate themed issue.

route.conditions: Select an appropriate upcoming issue and follow its submission deadline. October 2025 instructions list research articles, systematic reviews and analytic essays. Submitting does not guarantee acceptance; confirm article-specific requirements in the linked instructions. All issues are immediately open access.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated for article submission, processing or publication. Author reprints and advertisements are separate services.

fee_evidence.note: Current submission page excludes all submission/processing costs and explicitly says no fee is charged for article submission or publication.
Publisher confirms immediate open access and repeats the no-submission-or-publication-fee policy.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty ranking established in expansion; independent ranking review pending.

records.name: Preventing Chronic Disease
records.publisher: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
records.scope_notes: Chronic-disease prevention, population health and public-health practice. Existing surveillance/survey analyses, GIS analyses, program evaluation and systematic reviews can fit. Scoping reviews do not qualify as systematic reviews. A current-data requirement limits reuse of older datasets.

route.conditions: Official policy broadly excludes fees associated with publishing, but a separately explicit no-submission-fee statement was not found. Data from surveys, surveillance systems or studies should not be older than two years at submission. CDC publication policies apply. Article categories have different limits and review rules.
route.other_mandatory_costs: Publishing charges are expressly excluded; submission fee remains separately unconfirmed. Copyright permissions for reused material are the authors' responsibility.

fee_evidence.note: Current CDC author policy states there are no fees or charges associated with publishing articles and free reader access. It does not separately name submission fees; retained conservatively for audit.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty ranking established in expansion; independent ranking review pending.

notes: Five additional journals, with four directly verified free submission/publication routes and one conservative needs_verification route. Discovery-file titles were checked to avoid duplicates. No preprint/repository records were added.

Publication scope is limited here to OSRI's nonclinical population-health, existing-data, methodological and evidence-synthesis research. Journal-wide laboratory/clinical coverage does not expand OSRI's program.

Excluded stale no-fee lead: Thai Journal of Public Health. The university's older author page (https://www.ph.mahidol.ac.th/thjph/author/, last updated September 2022) still says no submission or publication fees. Its linked current submission instructions (https://he02.tci-thaijo.org/index.php/jph/about/submissions, updated 28 October 2026) require USD 220 after acceptance, effective 1 June 2026. The live submission policy overrides the stale page.

Revista Española de Salud Pública is a further credible lead: its currently linked March 2025 instructions (https://www.sanidad.gob.es/biblioPublic/publicaciones/recursos_propios/resp/pdf/NORMAS_PUBLICACION_MARZO2025.pdf) explicitly exclude publication charges, but separate submission-fee absence was not established. It was not added within this five-journal expansion cap.

Current-data and language constraints are substantive: RESS requires Portuguese submissions and SUS relevance while funding translation; JCCPSL normally considers studies within five years; PCD states a two-year data cutoff. Delaware's geographic and themed-issue constraints must be checked before matching a manuscript.

All fee evidence in these records was read on official venue/publisher pages, not inferred from third-party no-APC lists. Peer-review policies were directly inspected. Fees are distinct from acceptance, and no citation metric or acceptance probability was inferred. No venue was contacted or research submitted.
